name: South West Pinnacle Exploration Ltd
tagline: Cheap, fast-growing coal/mineral drilling-and-exploration contractor (NSE: SOUTHWEST) riding India's mining-capex and critical-minerals-exploration push - record order book, net cash, ~17.5x P/E against 35% revenue growth and 101% profit growth, entering gold exploration and a self-funded Rs 400 Cr Jharkhand coal-block capex plan.
business_overview: State.json name 'Southwest Pinnacle Exports' does not match any listed entity exactly; resolved with high confidence to South West Pinnacle Exploration Ltd (NSE: SOUTHWEST, BSE: 543986) - the name is otherwise unique in the market and 'Exports' vs 'Exploration' reads as an X-source typo/mis-transcription, not a different company. Provides end-to-end drilling and exploration services (coal, ferrous, non-ferrous, atomic, base-metal) to PSU miners (Hindustan Zinc, NALCO, CMPDI, coal blocks) and is now diversifying into gold exploration and RC drilling, plus developing its own Jharkhand coal block.

fundamentals_narrative: A small-cap drilling/exploration contractor compounding off a low base: FY26 revenue grew 35% to Rs 243 Cr and net profit more than doubled (+101%) to Rs 33 Cr, funded from a net-cash balance sheet. The ~17.5x trailing P/E is not demanding for that growth rate. The company is broadening beyond its core coal/mineral drilling base into gold exploration and RC drilling (three new orders, ~Rs 21.5-22.7 Cr) and is developing its own Jharkhand coal block (~Rs 400 Cr capex, mostly internal accruals + bank support + offtake agreements) - a genuine second growth leg rather than pure order-book churn. Working-capital risk is real: debtor days are high (~155 days), typical of PSU-client contracting, and the business is order-book-lumpy with limited structural moat beyond client relationships and rig fleet.
